conviction_note: Four small positive leans: a strong read-through from the direct wafer-container competitor, a Q1 run-rate ahead of a plan that only matches consensus, last year's H1 buyback and dividend raise, and margin shorts building. They sum to +1.9. The scaled number is (2x0.56-1)x4.5 = +0.54, because every lean is public or inferred, the company did not revise at last year's H1, and this name has sold in-line prints hard (-8.9% on Q1, -4.2% on last year's H1 despite a buyback). The gap between the two numbers is that uncertainty about the sign.
bar: IFIS consensus via Monex scouter (as of 2026-07-22): H1 OP 7,700m yen, Q2 OP 3,950m, FY OP 15,900m / ordinary 16,000m; company FY plan OP 16,000m / ordinary 16,000m (2026-07-23), and kabuyoho shows the FY ordinary consensus still at 16,000m as of 2026-10-23. https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/7970_20260723_act_20260723_153018_2 ; https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=7970. The H1 consensus predates the Q1 beat, so it is stale. My estimate of H1 OP is about 8,000-8,400m.

findings.finding: Q1 OP of 4,148m yen is 25.9% of the 16,000m FY plan and beat IFIS Q1 consensus by about 10% (ordinary 4,125m vs 3,750m), while the FY plan only equals consensus. The remaining three quarters need about 3,950m each, below the Q1 run-rate. The stale H1 consensus of 7,700m needs only about 3,550m in Q2, against a weak Q2 FY26 base of 3,290m (-11% YoY). So the H1 likely beats, the Q2 YoY headline turns positive (last year's read '7-9月期は営業2ケタ減'), and an upward FY revision is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 (2025-10-23): no FY revision, Q2 OP -11% YoY, H1 ordinary below IFIS; the stock fell -4.21% despite a dividend raise and a buyback. Q1 FY27 (2026-07-23): Q1 beat consensus by 10% but the FY guide only matched it; -8.88% next day. Q1 FY26 (2025-07-23): first guide plus a strong Q1; +8.67%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at 2,247, the same level as after the Q1 sell-off (2,257 on 07-24), so it holds no upgrade over a guide sold as 'surprise-free'. If the run-rate had been priced, the post-Q1 drop would have reversed, and the consensus FY would sit above the plan; kabuyoho still shows them equal. Caveat, sized in: anyone can compute this from the last 短信, the company did not revise at last year's H1, and its 5-year average H1 progress rate is about 50% (kabutan, 2025-10-23).
findings.independence: Shares one document with nothing else here. The consensus numbers come from IFIS/Monex: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/7970_20260723_act_20260723_153018_2

findings.finding: Direct competitor Miraial (4238, world-top FOSB wafer shipping containers) reported Feb-Jul 2026 plastic-molding sales +29.7% YoY and guided Feb-Oct revenue +38.8% (implying about +65% YoY for Aug-Oct, partly M&A). Its CEO said the wafer-container picture had 'completely changed' this year, with strong demand for both shipping and in-process containers and price revisions planned. Semiconductor containers are the core of Shin-Etsu Polymer's precision molding segment, 52% of sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27: the containers were 'strong' but precision-molding segment profit fell -1.6% on +6.9% sales, and the stock fell -8.88% on a semis-weak day. So segment revenue strength has not by itself converted into margin or price.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 2026-09-08. Shin-Etsu Polymer rallied to 2,513 by 10-06 and then gave all of it back in the AI selloff, so the price carries the sector tape, not the company's Q2 container volume. If it were priced, the stock would not be back at its post-Q1 level. It is a competitor proxy, so it is sized small. Net of the rest of the company: electronic devices (22%, Q1 segment profit -12%) and housing (19%, Q1 +70%) have to hold.
findings.independence: Miraial's Q2 briefing transcript (same company, same event): https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4238&b=n202609250252. Shin-Etsu Polymer's own Q1 短信 also called the semiconductor containers strong (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260723598058.pdf).

findings.finding: At last year's equivalent H1 print (2025-10-23) the company raised the dividend by 4 yen and announced a 1bn yen / 500k-share (0.62%) buyback. The mid-term plan update (2025-11-07) targets a payout ratio of 50%+ and ROE of about 10%, against roughly 7.7-8% now, with about 50bn yen of cash and an 85% equity ratio. A repeat buyback with the H1 batch is plausible; a dividend raise needs an EPS upgrade, since 66/130.64 is already 50.5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-23: the dividend raise plus the 1bn buyback did not stop a -4.21% move on the Q2 profit decline. A 0.6%-of-cap buyback is small for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing about a buyback has been announced or guided this year; only the 33-yen interim is fixed. If the market expected a repeat, there would be no reason for margin shorts to quadruple into the print. Caveat: last year it did not move the stock, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Margin short balance quadrupled into the print, from 10.3k to 46.5k shares (09/25 -> 10/16), while margin longs fell from 116.9k to 99.3k; 信用倍率 went from 11.35 to 2.14. The leveraged long overhang has cleared and some short fuel has built.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is visible, but small: 46.5k shares is about 0.3 days of turnover, so it is fuel rather than a squeeze. The baseline lean scores the margin side as an overhang (-0.165) on the level alone, not on the trend.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is flat (+0.05) and the run-up is -4.3% over 20 days and -5.1% over 5, so a positive lean cuts mildly against the recent tape. The strongest positive the release could carry (an FY upgrade plus a buyback) was searched for: there is no pre-release revision, and last year's buyback came with the H1. The strongest negative is a repeat of last year's H1 (in-line, no revision, sold on margin) or another 'surprise-free' sell-off like Q1's -8.9%. The price already holds the semis tape and the public Miraial read-through, which is why p_up is only 56.
